narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are five primes, because all the odd numbers are prime.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>The odd houses are twenty one, twenty three, twenty five, twenty seven and twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='split'/>But twenty one is three times seven, and twenty five is five times five.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Those have more than two factors, so being odd does not make a number prime.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A prime has exactly two factors, and a composite has more than two.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. How many primes are there among the numbers from two to ten?
